text: Garbage trucks are required to enter a public lane located on the north side of Sudbury Street, east of Dovercourt Road. Occasionally, vehicles are parking near the lane blocking garbage trucks using the lane. Prohibiting standing on Sudbury Street at and near the lane will discourage motorists from parking in this area and it would provide better access to the lane. This proposal would not result in the loss of any parking spaces on Sudbury Street as there is a depressed curb in this area.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Prohibited standing at all times on the north side of Sudbury Street, between a point 46.6 metres east of Dovercourt Road and a point 19.8 metres further east.
